name: Banh tam
summary: One of the rice products of the Mỹ Phong noodle village, made alongside its hủ tiếu, bánh tét, bánh ít, and bánh hỏi.
howToEat: Look for it on a visit to the Mỹ Phong noodle village.
where: Ấp Hội Gia and ấp Mỹ Hòa in phường Mỹ Phong, and old phường 9, where the noodle yards open 07:00–18:00.
seoDescription: Bánh tầm from the Mỹ Phong noodle village, made alongside its hủ tiếu, bánh tét, bánh ít, and bánh hỏi.
